v.2: by those who sweep along like gale,
v.3: by those who publish [the Divine messages] far and wide,
v.4: by those who separate [the truth from falsehood] distinctly,
v.7: what you are promised will surely befall.
v.8: When the stars are blotted out
v.10: when the mountains are scattered [like dust]
v.11: and time is set for the apostles [to bear witness]
v.12: —for what day has [all] that been set [to occur]?
v.14: And what will show you what is the Day of Judgement!?
v.15: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.16: Did We not destroy the former generations,
v.17: [and] then made the latter ones follow them?
v.18: That is how We deal with the guilty.
v.19: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.20: Have We not created you from a base fluid,
v.21: [and] then lodged it in a secure abode
v.23: Then We determined; and how excellent determiners We are!
v.24: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.25: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
v.26: for the living and the dead,
v.27: and set in it lofty [and] firm mountains, and given you agreeable water to drink?
v.28: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.29: [The faithless will be told:] ‘Proceed toward what you used to deny!
v.31: neither shady nor of any avail against the flames.
v.32: Indeed it throws up [giant] sparks like castles,
v.34: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.35: This is a day wherein they will not speak,
v.36: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses.
v.37: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.38: ‘This is the Day of Judgement. We have brought you together with the former generations.
v.39: If you have any stratagems [left], try them out against Me!’
v.40: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.41: Indeed the Godwary will be amid shades and springs
v.42: and [enjoying] such fruits as they desire.
v.43: [They will be told:] ‘Enjoy your food and drink, [a reward] for what you used to do.
v.44: Thus do We reward the virtuous.’
v.45: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.46: ‘Eat and enjoy a little! You are indeed guilty.’
v.47: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.48: When they are told, ‘Bow down [in prayer],’ they do not bow down!
v.49: Woe to the deniers on that day!
v.50: So what discourse will they believe after this?
